_why: A report about a Venus isolated pool, which Pokter does not read. There are no figures of its own to compare, so it is unresolved rather than wrong — and it must be settled before any chain read is spent on it.
attribution: Synthetic report, written for this test suite. No agent delivered it and it is not the work of any external builder.

chain.note: The same real Core Pool state as 01-correct-report.json, at BNB Smart Chain block 129,170,001. It is present so the suite can prove the Core Pool figures are never compared with a report about another pool: the refusal happens before the read, and the figures here are the ones a careless verifier would have reached for. The state is real; the report is synthetic.

legs._note: As 01-correct-report.json. Liquidation thresholds captured; collateral factors synthetic and set equal to them.

report._fixture: Synthetic ProofRun fixture. Not a delivery by any agent.
report.summary: Health factor 1.1223 in the Venus Stablecoins pool at block 129,170,001.

expect._whyUnresolvedAndNotWrong: Each Venus isolated pool has its own Comptroller and its own account liquidity. A Core Pool reading is not a figure about the Stablecoins pool, so there is nothing to disagree with. Reporting this as 'differs' would put a finding against a report that may be entirely right about a pool Pokter cannot read.
